scenes.title: When can I retire?
scenes.say: When can you actually retire? Not someday. A real age, worked out from your real numbers.

scenes.title: Your whole net worth. One dashboard.
scenes.say: fire is a self-hosted FIRE tracker. Every account you own lands on one dashboard: net worth, income, spending, and how close you are to financial independence.

scenes.title: Everything counts.
scenes.say: Brokerage and Roth accounts, high-yield savings, an ENS wallet, gold by the ounce, CDs. And yes, even the 2014 Malibu.

scenes.title: Stress-test your retire date.
scenes.say: Projections turn that into a retirement date. Then stress-test it. A bear market pushes it out, a bull market pulls it in.

scenes.title: 🌪️ Chaos mode
scenes.say: Chaos mode rolls real life onto the plan. A layoff, a vet bill, an inheritance. So the date you plan around survives surprises.

scenes.title: Insights that tell you what to fix.
scenes.say: Insights flags what you're over-exposed to, losses you can harvest before year end, and the trades that get you back to your target mix.

scenes.title: Side hustles count too.
scenes.say: The Side Hustle Hub works out your real margin after platform fees, and connected eBay sales flow straight into your ledger.

scenes.title: Ask Claude about your money.
scenes.sub: 16 read-only MCP tools + the fire-coach skill
scenes.prompt: how close am I to FIRE?
scenes.say: And Claude can read all of it. Sixteen read-only MCP tools and a FIRE coach skill answer with your actual numbers.

scenes.title: Your money. Your machine.
scenes.say: Your data lives in one file on your own machine, encrypted at rest. fire is read-only, so it never moves a cent. And it's open source.

scenes.title: Your money. Your machine.
